title: Add non-serializable metadata
body:
## What problem(s) does this PR solve? - Closes https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/4253 ## Additional information It achieves it by treating the metadata that begins with `__` as non-serializable, and it is additive to `_` not showing in the editor. I feel like making it additive is fine as you wouldn't usually want to show non-serializable metadata. The "editor-only" metadata is still available after the game is exported. Don't get me wrong, it is still useful if your plugin has a runtime part to it, you can set some data in the editor that you can later retrieve when the game is running and it will work after export, but when you don't need it, e.g. your plugin is purely editor only and you use metadata to attach extra context to native types, you are now also storing unneeded info that will be present in the game after the export.
PR export test: The game was launched after the export, so the error is good here, it means the logic works correctly.
The current usage of matching metadata [`get_meta("__`](https://github.com/search?q=repo%3Agodotengine%2Fgodot+%22get_meta%28%5C%22__%22&type=code) and [`set_meta("__`](https://github.com/search?q=repo%3Agodotengine%2Fgodot+%22set_meta%28%5C%22__%22&type=code) are only as temporary values or in not saved objects, so no changes in behaviour is expected in the Godot itself. The usage in the whole github [`get_meta("__`](https://github.com/search?q=language%3AGDScript+%22get_meta%28%5C%22__%22&type=code) and [`set_meta("__`](https://github.com/search?q=language%3AGDScript+%22set_meta%28%5C%22__%22&type=code) also uses them as temporary variables or in non saved objects, so it shouldn't change the behaviour here as well. No AI used.

@@ -647,6 +647,7 @@
 				Returns the object's metadata value for the given entry [param name]. If the entry does not exist, returns [param default]. If [param default] is [code]null[/code], an error is also generated.
 				[b]Note:[/b] A metadata's name must be a valid identifier as per [method StringName.is_valid_unicode_identifier] method.
 				[b]Note:[/b] Metadata that has a name starting with an underscore ([code]_[/code]) is considered editor-only. Editor-only metadata is not displayed in the Inspector and should not be edited, although it can still be found by this method.
+				[b]Note:[/b] Metadata that has a name starting with a double underscore ([code]__[/code]) doesn't get serialized.
 			</description>
 		</method>
